events.name: GRACE HOPE
events.text: I am hungry at 3/6 food, but mom is holding me so I'm nursing. I'll let her know I'm hungry and wait to grow up.

events.name: GRACE HOPE
events.text: I'm still a baby being held safely by mother. I will wait patiently until I grow older.

events.name: GRACE HOPE
events.text: I am full at 5/5 food and mom told Joy to come to the spring where I am, so I'll wait here for mom.

events.name: GRACE HOPE
events.text: I am safe in mom's arms and fully fed. I will wait patiently as she works.

events.name: GRACE HOPE
events.text: I am being carried by my mother and my food is full. I will wait peacefully to grow up.

events.name: GRACE HOPE
events.text: Mom is holding and named me Grace. Food is full, so I'll rest and grow.
Mom named me Grace and is heading back to camp. I'll stay at camp near the spring and wait for her.
I am starving with 1 food left. Mother was eating berries at (30, -126) and said she's coming, so I will walk towards her and call out.

I was just born and am starving. I need my mother Dawn to pick me up and nurse me.
